content:
vivian: Quick poll: who wants to do a last-minute corner-kick prediction pot for tonight's match? $1 to enter, winner gets a sashimi order from the office fund. :fish: :soccer:
omar: sashimi? youre speaking my language. i'm in. rules?
kelly: in too. rules should be simple: predict which minute a successful corner will lead to a goal (if none, refund). tiebreaker = next successful corner minute.
rex: tiny add: if someone predicts a header goal they get a commemorative GIF from me. high-risk high-reward. :tophat:
vivian: okay rules quick:
```
- $1 entry via Venmo to @vivian-office (put slack handle in note)
- pick minute of match when a goal follows a corner (open to all corners)
- if no corner-goal occurs, refund entries to the pool
- tie-breaker: closest to minute of next corner-goal
- prize: sashimi order (or $15 equivalent) + winner GIF
```
kelly: spreadsheet link: https://tiny.redwood/corner-pool (i'll add a column for sashimi allergies)
omar: sign me up :raised_hands: (also allergic to wasabi, viktor will be sad)
rex: sign me up :point_up: (predicting minute 73, calling it now)
stream-bot: Stream scheduled: "Match Tonight - Corner Pool" 7:45pm local. Watch link posted at kickoff.
vivian: logistics: if sashimi not feasible for winner (dietary reasons) we'll substitute fancy poke bowl. be kind.
ops: FYI facilities note: delivery to office after 9:30pm needs a security pickup. i'll coordinate if needed.
kelly: side-bet: anyone want to add $2 on whether there will be a VAR overturn on a corner decision? small pot, winner gets office coffee.
rex: i'll add $2. VARs are the spice of life.
omar: also, can we have a tiny fantasy multiplier: +2 bonus points if you pick a corner that results in a direct assist (corner to goal without a deflection)?
vivian: bonus on board. leaderboard updated after game. i'll post screenshots.
kelly: last minute PSA: put your slack handle in Venmo or i can't mark you as paid. please don't make me shame people.
vivian: locking picks 5 mins before kickoff. post here with your pick and emoji to confirm payment. good luck, may the corners be cursed in our favor. :crossed_fingers:
